feed.title: The VJS Gazette
feed.subtitle: The record of the realm: the living canon and the honoured archive
feed.rights: Publication is constitutively inert (REG-GAZETTE-CONTINUITY-001): force comes from the lawpack and the Sovereign's assent, never from publication or syndication.

entry.title: Governance (The Order)
entry.summary: V2 runtime uses orders, rules, and logs as authority; V1 archive not runtime context unless incorporated.

entry.title: Archive (The Order)
entry.summary: V1 archive is historical and persuasive; not live runtime law unless expressly incorporated.

entry.title: Court Structure (The Order)
entry.summary: Court of Appeal not carried forward in V2 MVP; appeals handled by Privy Council or Supreme Court.

entry.title: Logs (The Order)
entry.summary: Material implementation decisions require 50-150 word decision logs.

entry.title: Mcp (The Order)
entry.summary: MCP adapter exposes only 6 tools; local-first; no release tools or direct file writes.

entry.title: Kernel Determinism (The Order)
entry.summary: Kernel must remain deterministic, model-free, and network-free.

entry.title: Invariants (The Order)
entry.summary: Invariants are deterministic, typed, evaluated mechanically using fixed predicate registry.

entry.title: Specs (The Order)
entry.summary: Specs are first-class law objects with purpose, scope, decisions, invariants, obligations, and review triggers.

entry.title: Permits (The Order)
entry.summary: Permits required for governed writes; hooks enforce lifecycle (permit check, pre-commit validation), not the law itself.

entry.title: Boundary (The Order)
entry.summary: Public/private boundary enforced by deterministic scanner, not model judgment.

entry.title: Alpha Hardening (The Order)
entry.summary: V2 alpha must harden predicate evaluation, repo scanning, invariant validation, permits, hooks before adding courts, Gazette, migration.

entry.title: Permit Enforcement Hardening Order
entry.summary: V2 alpha must enforce permits at staged-change and commit boundary before further expansion.

entry.title: Overnight Gazette Work Programme Order
entry.summary: Overnight run: execute the Principal's Gazette presentation mandate with derived PDFs for the 7 gaps, two-chip rule, compact header, gated commits, and morning acceptance on tests, live checks, screenshots and logs.

entry.title: Court Constitution (The Order)
entry.summary: V2 courts expressly constituted with odd benches; County 1, Privy Council 3, Supreme Court 5/9; Court of Appeal persists but non-convened.

entry.title: Transition and Onboarding (The Order)
entry.summary: 3-0 Privy Council ruling on V1->V2 transitional-continuity doctrine, pending matter classification, and local onboarding.

entry.title: Repository Topology (The Order)
entry.summary: 3-0 Privy Council ruling consolidating onto established public repo as one canonical line with two-estate Gazette.

entry.title: S23 sc10 Location (The Order)
entry.summary: 3-0 Privy Council ruling on back-filling s.23 and SC-10 into V1 archival estate with proper estate marking.

entry.title: Foundational Law Citation (The Order)
entry.summary: 3-0 Privy Council ruling on citation convention: cite statute by instrument+section, case law by its case (neutral citation).

entry.title: Institutions and Repos House (The Order)
entry.summary: 3-0 Privy Council ruling on Repos House as declarative registry and institutional model.

entry.title: Superrepo Self Invocation (The Order)
entry.summary: 3-0 Privy Council ruling that canon super-repo self-invokes under REG-INVOCATION-001; Privy Council is realm first-instance court.

entry.title: Federation Extraction Canonicalisation (The Order)
entry.summary: 9-0 Supreme Court ruling on federation test, V1 incorporation, canonicalisation governance, and constitutional directives.

entry.title: Constitution and Sources of Authority Act
entry.summary: Establishes V2 constitutional foundation, sources of authority hierarchy, and kernel as runtime authority surface.

entry.title: Courts and Orders Act
entry.summary: Establishes three-court structure (County, Privy Council, Supreme), order binding rules, and word limits.

entry.title: Agent Duties and Route Act
entry.summary: Defines agent duties, kernel routing for governed work, and permit-obligation-proof-log lifecycle.

entry.title: Records, Logs, Specs and Invariants Act
entry.summary: Defines typed records, invariants as deterministic checks, and citation/supersession rules.

entry.title: Public and Private Boundary Act
entry.summary: Enforces public/private boundary, keeps public records system-data-only, and localizes private operational facts.

entry.title: External Acts and Release Authority Act
entry.summary: Governs external acts, public releases, destructive operations, and requires human checkpoints for irreversible actions.

entry.title: Federation and Local Sovereignty Act
entry.summary: Establishes local jurisdiction on VJS installation, default subscription to lawpack, and local variation rules.

entry.title: Computer-First Realm Act 2026
entry.summary: Founding constitutional Act declaring V2 a computer-first legal system with kernel-governed compact lawpack.

entry.title: Realm Consolidation and Reconciliation Framework Act 2026
entry.summary: Consolidating constitutional Act restating V1 law, establishing subordinate regulation power, and protecting core principles.

entry.title: Memory Is Not Authority
entry.summary: Retrieve current authority from kernel before governed load-bearing work; memory is not source of law.

entry.title: Kernel-first Lifecycle
entry.summary: Agent must follow full route-permit-proof-log-validate lifecycle for implementation decisions and public changes.

entry.title: [2026] Computer-First Realm Act
entry.summary: Founding statute for VJS V2 (Computer-First Realm); establishes V2 machinery and handover conditions.

entry.title: Private Facts Stay Local
entry.summary: Public records must not contain private facts, secrets, tokens, or unredacted evidence.

entry.title: Agent lifecycle - route, permit, obligations, proof, log, validate
entry.summary: Agents performing load-bearing work (implementation decisions, public record changes, external acts, security-sensitive acts) shall follow the route-permit-obligations-proof-log-validate lifecycle.

entry.title: Prompts do not create governance capability
entry.summary: Agents are governed by kernel tools, deterministic validation, permits, proofs, logs, evals; not long prompts.

entry.title: AI legislature competence bounds - delegated lawmaking conditions and assent_source semantics
entry.summary: Delegated lawmaking by AI agents is conditional on express Sovereign assent and bounded by prohibited subjects.

entry.title: Assent lifecycle gates - from draft to Gazette entry and adoption
entry.summary: No law object acquires binding force by silence, default, or implied assent.

entry.title: Kernel determinism mandate
entry.summary: The kernel must be deterministic, local-first, and independent of model judgement.

entry.title: Kernel refactor and dependency constraints
entry.summary: Kernel refactors, dependency additions, network capability introductions, model call introductions, and authority-ranking changes must be gated by judicial review.

entry.title: V2 silence is a V2 question, not a V1 revival
entry.summary: V2 gap does not auto-import V1 as binding; gaps are V2 first-impression questions; V1 may be consulted.

entry.title: Agents cannot bypass the route-permit-obligations-proof-log-validate lifecycle
entry.summary: Reject all implementation decisions, public record changes, external acts, and security-sensitive acts that lack a valid permit, contemporaneous decision log, and proof of validation.

entry.title: Permit precedence, contemporaneous obligation log, post-execution validation
entry.summary: Every change to crates/** must carry a contemporaneous decision log.

entry.title: Agent harness changes require eval coverage
entry.summary: Agent harness, hook, or prompt changes trigger requirement for evaluation fixture coverage.

entry.title: Assent-source mandatory on all runtime-force records
entry.summary: Every statute, regulation, order, and decision file must carry an assent_source field with a value of either sovereign_assent or standing_bounded_assent, tracing to a recorded Sovereign assent event.

entry.title: Delegated lawmaking must declare and preserve prohibited_subjects
entry.summary: Any change to the SPEC-ASSENT-DRAFT-001 spec file (which declares the prohibited_subjects list for AI-operated lawmaking) must preserve the string "prohibited" in the file.

entry.title: Assent-Source Invariant - all runtime authority must trace to Sovereign assent
entry.summary: Every record claiming binding force must declare valid assent_source (sovereign or standing_bounded); fail-closed allow-list.

entry.title: Section 14 entrenchment gate preservation
entry.summary: Section 14 is entrenched against machine amendment.

entry.title: VJS hooks stay short state checks
entry.summary: Hooks must stay under 40 words; long hooks are fatal severity.

entry.title: Kernel determinism
entry.summary: Remove all model calls (calls to Claude, GPT, Gemini, or other LLM APIs) from the kernel.

entry.title: Kernel local-first and network-free
entry.summary: Remove all network calls and external service dependencies from the kernel.

entry.title: Kernel changes require judicial review gates
entry.summary: Record a decision log explaining the kernel refactor, dependency change, network capability introduction, or authority-ranking change.

entry.title: V2 silence does not import V1 as binding law
entry.summary: V1 archive must not be loaded as gap-filler for V2 silence; silence is fatal if V1 auto-imported.

entry.title: Prompt patches require a recorded rationale
entry.summary: Prompt or agent harness changes must have a decision log explaining the rationale.

entry.title: Kernel Dependency Policy
entry.summary: Kernel code must stay auditable and deterministic; extra crates require explicit safety or correctness reason.

entry.title: Assent-source mandatory at commencement
entry.summary: Every law object (statute, regulation, order, decision, invariant, obligation) that claims binding runtime force must declare and provide an assent_source field before commencement.

entry.title: Delegated lawmaking validates every change against prohibited_subjects
entry.summary: Any AI-operated lawmaking machinery, delegated authority system, or automated law-authoring tool must evaluate every proposed change against the prohibited_subjects list published in the competence grant (recorded in SPEC-ASSENT-DRAFT-001 or the grant instrument).

entry.title: Decision log obligation for governed actions
entry.summary: Every agent action on load-bearing work (implementation decisions, public record changes, external acts, security-sensitive acts) shall carry a contemporaneous decision log recording the intent, authorization route, permit id, decision rationale, and proof of validation.

entry.title: Kernel refactors and dependency changes pass determinism tests before merge
entry.summary: Kernel refactors, dependency additions, network capability introductions, and model call removals must be covered by determinism tests before merge.

entry.title: Validation proof obligation for agent actions with conditions
entry.summary: Agent actions that route as AllowedWithConditions shall carry validation proof (vjs validate output) before commit, confirming that the work and its decision log satisfy all lawpack invariants.

entry.title: [2026] REALM-PC 24 - VJS V2 Founding and Continuity
entry.summary: V2 founding lawful in principle only if runs through V1 organs, preserves single apex; founding limbs leapfrogged to Supreme Court.

entry.title: [2026] REALM-SC 10 - V1-to-V2 Migration Handover Minute
entry.summary: Derived minute (archival): V1-to-V2 migration lawful on continuity; enacted CASE-LAW s. 23 Sovereign-assent floor.

entry.title: Lawpack Manifest Regulation
entry.summary: Defines lawpack manifest fields, versioning, digest, lockfile, and schema validation.

entry.title: Directory Roles Regulation
entry.summary: Defines configurable directory roles for VJS records with one fixed anchor: .vjs/config.toml.

entry.title: Citation and ID Regulation
entry.summary: Defines citation formats for VJS records: VJS-ACT, VJS-REG, VJS-SC, VJS-PC, VJS-CC, LOG, SPEC, INV, DEC, PERMIT, PROOF.

entry.title: Route, Permit and Proof Regulation
entry.summary: Defines lifecycle for governed work: route -> permit -> action -> proof -> log -> validate -> close.

entry.title: Word Limit Regulation
entry.summary: Defines word limits for court output and decision records to keep authority compact.

entry.title: Default Invariant Suite Regulation
entry.summary: Bootstraps the default deterministic invariant suite for V2 kernel evaluation.

entry.title: MCP Safety Regulation
entry.summary: Defines MCP safety requirements: local-first, explicit repo root, limited write tools, audit log, human confirmation.

entry.title: Gazette and Archive Regulation
entry.summary: Defines V1 as Gazette and archive; V2 runtime does not load V1 by default unless incorporated.

entry.title: Canonicalisation and Migration Regulation
entry.summary: Makes canonicalisation a governed, lock-preserving migration; immutable digests, citations, IDs; no mass edits.

entry.title: Federation Coordination Regulation
entry.summary: Defines coordination vs sovereignty test; default subscription lawful because revocable; no binding without adoption.

entry.title: Gazette-Continuity and Publication Regulation
entry.summary: One Gazette with two estates; publication is constitutively inert; force from lawpack and kernel status, not publication.

entry.title: Functional Hook Regulation
entry.summary: Hooks are deterministic functions returning typed decisions (allow, warn, block, require_route, require_log, require_proof).

entry.title: Local Sovereign Invocation Regulation
entry.summary: Repository becomes VJS jurisdiction by local sovereign invocation, not directory ancestry; binding by invocation + lock + hooks.

entry.title: Lawpack Amendment and Legislative Intake Regulation
entry.summary: Defines legislative intake: proposal, validation, adoption, citation, lawpack entry; all new law starts as draft.

entry.title: Migration and Incorporation Regulation
entry.summary: Operationalizes incorporation pipeline; V1 law crosses only by express incorporation record with validity finding.

entry.title: Automated Release Warrant Regulation
entry.summary: Release warrant is deterministic pre-push gate checking remote/ref/SHA, boundary scan, and authorising instrument.

entry.title: Repos House, Certification, and the Two-Layer Registry Regulation
entry.summary: Made under the Consolidation Framework Act s.7, this Regulation establishes Repos House as a non-sovereign, two-layer declarative registry and certification ledger for V2 repositories.

entry.title: Repos Register and Subscription Regulation
entry.summary: Mandatory transition-subscription: repos create .vjs/config.toml, declare lineage, default-subscribe within 90 days.

entry.title: Self-Convening and No-Fork-to-Principal Regulation
entry.summary: Agent must self-convene court for forks on symmetric case file; never route fork to Principal for decision.

entry.title: Transition-Court and Continuity Regulation
entry.summary: Privy Council is transition court classifying pending V1 matters as continued, reframed, or moot; V1 Court perfects only.

entry.title: VJS agent harness and prompting spec
entry.summary: Ensures agents governed by compact prompts, kernel tools, deterministic evals, and repair loops.

entry.title: Sovereign assent and AI legislature competence (draft implementation brief)
entry.summary: Draft scaffold for assent field system pending V1 constitutional route settlement; not binding.

entry.title: V1 is archive, not runtime
entry.summary: V1 preserved as Gazette and archive; V2 runtime uses compact lawpack; only expressly migrated V1 binds.

entry.title: Orders bind, opinions explain
entry.summary: Kernel applies orders and rule atoms; opinions explain but do not bind unless incorporated.

entry.title: No Court of Appeal in V2 MVP
entry.summary: V2 uses County Court, Privy Council, and Supreme Court only; Court of Appeal deferred.

entry.title: Kernel first, MCP second
entry.summary: Rust kernel is authoritative runtime machinery; MCP is adapter; kernel must not depend on MCP.

entry.title: Configurable directories
entry.summary: VJS binds records by schema, ID, and configured role, not by ceremonial path.

entry.title: No semantic authority matching
entry.summary: Binding authority resolved by tags, jurisdiction, rank, status, scope, supersession; not cosine similarity.

entry.title: Legislation is YAML-first
entry.summary: V2 legislation is canonical as schema-validated YAML; Markdown is rendered explanation only.

entry.title: Lawpack validates
entry.summary: Lawpack must validate before proceeding; validation failure is fatal.

entry.title: No duplicate IDs
entry.summary: All record IDs must be unique; duplicates are fatal.

entry.title: No duplicate citations
entry.summary: All citations must be unique; duplicates are fatal.

entry.title: Orders have operative directives
entry.summary: Every order must have directives and runtime summary; absence is fatal.

entry.title: Public records contain no private facts
entry.summary: Public records must not contain private facts, secrets, or unredacted evidence.

entry.title: vjs-core has no model calls
entry.summary: Core kernel code must not contain model calls, LLM interactions, or semantic search.

entry.title: vjs-core has no network calls
entry.summary: Core kernel code must not contain network clients or direct network calls.

entry.title: Governed writes require permit
entry.summary: Governed writes must have matching valid permit; absence is error severity.

entry.title: Required proofs exist before permit closes
entry.summary: Permits cannot close without required proofs; absence is error severity.

entry.title: Decision logs are short
entry.summary: Decision logs must be 50-150 words; overlong or too-short logs are error severity.

entry.title: MCP is local-first
entry.summary: MCP server must bind to local interface only; network exposure is error severity.

entry.title: Directory roles resolve inside repo
entry.summary: Configured directory paths must resolve within the repo; escapes are error severity.

entry.title: V1 archive not loaded by default
entry.summary: V1 archive must not be loaded as runtime authority by default; default loading is error severity.

entry.title: New law requires authority basis
entry.summary: New law records must have authority, status, and kernel_effect fields; missing is fatal.

entry.title: Draft law is not binding
entry.summary: Records with status=draft must not be included in runtime authority graph; draft binding is fatal.

entry.title: Agent lifecycle spec
entry.summary: Agent must follow route-permit-obligations-proof-log-validate lifecycle for all governed load-bearing work.

entry.title: VJS kernel determinism spec
entry.summary: Ensures core kernel remains deterministic, local-first, and independent of model judgment.

entry.title: Lawpack amendment spec
entry.summary: Ensures new legislation enters V2 through proposal, validation, adoption, citation, lawpack entry, and decision log.

entry.summary: Super-repo is realm-as-state; REALM-PC is DISTINCT central constitutional first-instance court, not County Court.

entry.summary: Real-world law is external supremacy floor; VJS never authorises unlawful action; agents must escalate illegality.

entry.title: [2026] REALM-SI 9 - Gazette Graph Database
entry.summary: Gazette graph database infrastructure; governs law reporting, Gazette publication, graph data model for legal relations.

entry.title: [2026] Enforcement, Sanctions and Compliance Act
entry.summary: Enforcement mechanisms, sanctions, compliance procedures; governs agent security, break-glass, audited delegation.

entry.title: [2026] Autonomous Execution and Safety Act
entry.summary: Agent autonomy, execution safety, capability-is-not-authority doctrine, outward-act controls.

entry.title: [2026] Legislature of the Realm Act

entry.title: [2026] Repositories and Records Certification Act

entry.summary: Lexby holds NO law-making authority; text void as instrument but admissible as void first draft; adoption is constitutive cure.

entry.title: [2026] REALM-PC 13 - Agent Security Fork Reference
entry.summary: Secure and operable defaults unified on fail-closed control with audited break-glass; no self-elevation on ingested instruction.

entry.summary: Deterministic token-free retrieval index permitted screening device under s.12 on cumulative conditions; gate presently FORBIDDEN.

entry.title: [2026] REALM-SC 1 - Tort Recast and Foundational Settlement
entry.summary: Breach reconceived as tort of negligence; unitary realm of parliamentary sovereignty with single apex.

entry.title: [2026] REALM-SC 2 - Proactive Disclosure Obligation
entry.summary: Lexby must proactively disclose material risks; silence is breach.

entry.title: [2026] REALM-SC 3 - Six Procedural Reforms
entry.summary: Six reforms: reviewable leapfrog, two-sided intake, apex observer, leave-judge independence, watchdog, deterministic citator.

entry.title: [2026] REALM-SC 4 - Odd Benches and Bench Constitution
entry.summary: All benches must be odd-numbered; synthesiser-on-top pattern abolished; improper benches void ab initio.

entry.title: [2026] REALM-SC 5 - Unitary Court With Domain Divisions
entry.summary: Single spine with domain DIVISIONS, never fractured into parallel domain COURTS.

entry.summary: Super-repo permitted with distributed County Courts, but apex singleness absolute and non-delegable.

entry.summary: Pre-enactment precedent judged entry-by-entry, never wholesale; Bill 25 s.6(2) and CASE-LAW s.18(5) interlock.

entry.title: [2026] REALM-SC 8 - Lexby Has No Law-making Authority
entry.summary: Lexby holds NO law-making authority; un-adopted text void but curable as void first draft.
